<message>
My coworker takes credit for my work and it's eating at me
</message>
output: You are disturbed by another's actions, yet you cannot control them. Focus on your own conduct: do your work with integrity and let the results speak for themselves. The opinion of others is not your concern; only your own virtue matters. Let go of the resentment, for it is a poison you drink while hoping the other will suffer.
